_documentation: Owner: r2fc-file-cleanup3.md Groups2/13. Portable observed requirements, not a CMakeCache transfer or a claim of destination-machine qualification. Machine paths are discovery output in test-cache/cleanup/boundary.json.

discovery.python: Discover the selected Python executable and compare its version with the selected pack scope.
discovery.cmake: Discover PATH CMake or the selected Visual Studio CMake installation; supply it explicitly.
discovery.compiler: Discover Visual Studio BuildTools/MSVC and Windows SDK; never transfer a machine-local compiler cache.
discovery.vcpkg: Discover or supply an external vcpkg root at the source-declared baseline; install dependencies into the declared local build owner.
discovery.grf: Discover or supply GRFCodec, grfid and nforenum executables matching the selected source scope.
